import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { UserHttpService } from 'src/app/user-http.service'; import { AirlinesService } from 'src/app/services/airlines.service'; import { TicketsService, Tickets } from 'src/app/services/tickets.service'; import { Aircrafts } from 'src/app/services/aircrafts.service'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-dashboard', templateUrl: './dashboard.component.html', styleUrls: ['./dashboard.component.css'] }) export class DashboardComponent implements OnInit { adminRole = false; airlineRole = false; passengerRole = false; aircrafts: Aircrafts[] = []; tickets: Tickets[] = []; constructor( private us: UserHttpService, private airlinesService: AirlinesService, private ticketsService: TicketsService, private router: Router ) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.adminRole = this.us.is_admin(); this.airlineRole = this.us.is_airline(); this.passengerRole = this.us.is_passenger(); if (this.airlineRole) { const email = this.us.get_mail(); /*this.airlinesService.getAirlineByMail(email).subscribe({ next: res => { console.log("Airline data:", res); this.aircrafts = res.aircrafts || []; }, error: err => { console.error("Errore caricamento airline:", err); } });*/ this.airlinesService.getAircraft().subscribe(res => { this.aircrafts = res; }) this.ticketsService.getTickets().subscribe(res => { console.log('Biglietti ricevuti:', res); // Debug temporaneo this.tickets = res; }); } } logout() { this.us.logout(); this.router.navigate(['/search']); } }
